A foundation service may only depend on brokers, exposures, or nothing.

What the Standard says

“Single Entity Integration” — A foundation service integrates with brokers or exposures and does not depend on higher service layers. This keeps it nearest to the external resource while still owning the first layer of business logic. read it here.

Why it matters

Foundations are the first business layer above external boundaries, so their dependencies are deliberately limited to brokers and exposures. Depending higher in the stack reverses the flow and makes foundational policy depend on workflows built on top of it.

Bad code example

// Violates STXF002: A foundation service may only depend on brokers, exposures, or nothing.
class StudentService(IStudentProcessingService students) : IStudentService { }

Good code example

// Follows STXF002
class StudentService(IStudentBroker students) : IStudentService { }
